verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy axis for a SaaS coding-agent platform like LightSprint, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. Self-hosting, model-gateway routing and sandbox egress controls are adjacent privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
